finding: Returning from a book to the signed-in viewer own web profile recreated empty posts and shelf state even after a recent visit.
changes: Synchronous in-memory paged-post and book-shelf restoration is limited to the currently signed-in owner profile and the existing navigation session scope.
Every profile mount still reads fresh server data in the background. Other viewers content is never restored from these snapshots.
Refresh re-reads all retained pages using one new server timestamp and keeps raw continuation offsets. It preserves local edits and deletions made during the refresh.
Duplicate foreground refreshes coalesce; newer mutation requests abort older reads. Account changes fence late RPC and media work, including A to B to A.
Successful book creation, presentation/visibility, page, caption and audience-access changes invalidate remembered shelf revisions even while the profile is unmounted.
Expired signed media URLs are stripped from restored rows while metadata remains available. Late media signing cannot overwrite newer row metadata.

retentionLimits.account: matching current viewer own profile only

node.invocation: env -u NODE_TEST_CONTEXT node <file>; actual internal node:test cases were executed

profileCases.name: real book Back restores owner posts and four books on every sampled frame during held refreshes
actual editor save invalidates off-route shelf revision and returns current title and private visibility
rapid successful shelf changes cancel the stale read and coalesce to the latest book revision
A to B to A clears warm content and cancels old transport before fresh results appear
visitor return waits for current visibility and removes revoked posts and books

scopeAndLimits: Browser execution uses actual web profile, posts, shelf, book reader/editor and navigation modules with synthetic Auth/RPC, media signing and Next route adapters.

Profile frame samples begin once the destination profile component is present; 1 post and 4 books are checked throughout held refreshes. This measures component content continuity and does not claim all-transition GPU paint timing, production network latency or hosted RSC speed.
Saved-book coverage uses the actual editor and save helper with synthetic authoritative revisions and audience data. It is not hosted Supabase authorization acceptance.
Native app source and music licensing configuration were not changed by this follow-up.
